notes.title: Two new Fighting Fantasy Classics gamebooks announced!
notes.content:
Our [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i] library will be getting two new additions, hailing from the masters themselves, Ian Livingstone and Steve Jackson. [i]Temple of Terror[/i] and [i]Creature of Havoc[/i] will be released later this year!

If you enjoy the choice-based adventure narrative in [i]Catacombs of the Undercity[/i], then maybe check out FFC, where you'll get to adventure through the pirate text adventure, [i]Bloodbones[/i], for free! The [i]Gamebook Adventures[/i] series was directly inspired by [i]Fighting Fantasy[/i] gamebooks of old.

[h3]Fighting Fantasy Classics:[/h3] https://store.steampowered.com/app/856880/Fighting_Fantasy_Classics/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11610847/f71d27bea2387d821ceeea18227c25f1aad727ce.png[/img]
[b]Written by Steve Jackson[/b]

[i]Are you ready for the most unusual Fighting Fantasy adventure yet?

You begin this adventure not knowing where you are or who you are. All you know is that you are some kind of creature of instinct, understanding little. During the course of the adventure, it may be possible for you to begin to control your bestial nature, to find out more about yourself, and even to learn your destiny. But even if you know all this, success is by no means certain, for the traps and terrors of Trolltooth Pass are many ... Are you ready — to become the Creature of Havoc?[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11610847/ac478e9d59cb46708b7fd445fb0035dae45737dd.png[/img]
[b]Written by Ian Livingstone[/b]

[i]The dark, twisted power of the young Malbordus is reaching its zenith!

All he needs now is to retrieve the five dragon artefacts which have been hidden for centuries in the lost city of Vatos, somewhere in the Desert of Skulls. Each day that passes brings him closer to them and only YOU can stop him! YOUR mission is to reach the lost city before Malbordus and destroy the treasures he seeks. But beware! Each step you take leads you closer to your doom ...[/i]

[h3]Two dice, [strike]a pencil and an eraser[/strike] are all you need to make your journey. YOU decide which route to follow, which dangers to risk and which foes to fight![/h3]

notes.title: New Fighting Fantasy Classics 25% OFF!
notes.content:
TRIAL OF CHAMPIONS has arrived! The sequel to [i]Deathtrap Dungeon[/i] joins a stellar roster of fantasy adventures in [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i] - the ultimate library of text-based role playing games. And to celebrate, it's 25% OFF! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/897190/Trial_of_Champions/]Check it out here.[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33039573/a6d64fdadb1fcc1c90a0c798cac92a41bbce8ed9.png[/img]

[i]Trial of Champions[/i] sees you delve into the dread corridors of Baron Sukumvit’s terrible challenge for a second stab at glory. But beware! The Trial will be even more devilishly difficult this time as you begin your adventure having been captured and sold into slavery! With nothing to prepare you for this arduous adventure but your SKILL, LUCK and STAMINA, you must explore the deadly labyrinth beneath Fang. For only by triumphing in the Trial can you win back your freedom from Baron Sukumvit’s evil brother – Lord Carnuss.

Will it be enough?!

Find out for yourself and pick up this classic title [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/897190/Trial_of_Champions/]while it's just 2.99 USD.[/url]

Also joining the [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i] shelf is another old favourite – Steve Jackson’s [i]House of Hell[/i]. We’ve remastered this title for the [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i] library, so it can take its rightful place amongst your collection. It is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/897180/House_of_Hell_Fighting_Fantasy_Classics/]also 25% OFF[/url] for a limited time. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33039573/2e02525bf6cbcfc88d0dbeb0a2e7103be93af2fc.png[/img]

[i]House of Hell’s[/i] addition to the library comes with a handful of updates including:
[list]
[*] Adventure Sheet now includes 'Fear' mechanic. 
[*] Knowledge Sheet to track the clues you discover.
[*] Tim Sell’s original artwork, as well as coloured editions of each piece.
[*] [i]Haunted Hallways[/i] ambient track added.
[*] Achievements added for both [i]Trial of Champions[/i] and [i]House of Hell[/i].
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33039573/aaf8f602b920bdc08fb7f9df81eeeee1bd82499c.png[/img]

Whether you're heading into the depths of the labyrinth beneath the city of Fang, or braving the haunted halls of the House of Drumer, may LUCK be with you and your STAMINA never fail!

notes.title: Summer Sale & New TMG Creator Homepage
notes.content:
Hello adventurers! 

We've got two exciting announcements for you today.

First, earlier this week Steam unveiled a new feature - the [b]Creator Homepage[/b]! We're really excited about this as it makes it easier than ever to stay up-to-date on all our latest game updates, news and discounts. 

By following the Tin Man Games Creator Homepage you can:  
[*] Easily access lists of all of our titles
[*] Quickly check for discounted games 
[*] Receive updates about what we're working on 
[*] Access lists and reviews of games curated by the team

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33039573/27616c8c68dae415b4d89e96c8f08d0fbbb0401b.png[/img]

...and as you can see from our Follower count, our shiny new Creator page could do with some love! Simply [url=https://store.steampowered.com/dev/tinmangames]click here[/url] to take a look for yourself and hit the green 'Follow' button at the top of the page to make use of this new feature. 

Second, the Steam Summer Sale is here! Many of our titles are discounted, with titles up to 65% OFF! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=Tin%20Man%20Games]Click here[/url] to see the full list. 

Happy gaming folks!
